                  <div style="font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-success); margin-top: 2px;">{{formatHMS(motorRunSeconds)}}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 5px 4px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3px;">DỪNG MÁY</div>
                  <div style="font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">{{formatHMS(machineStopSeconds)}}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 5px 4px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3px;">MẤT KẾT NỐI</div>
                  <div style="font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 2px;" ng-style="{'color': modbusOnline ? 'var(--text-muted)' : 'var(--color-danger)'}">
                    {{modbusOnline ? '00:00:00' : formatHMS(disconnectSeconds)}}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Panel Điều khiển nhanh -->
            <div class="card-panel">
              <div class="section-header-row">
                <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"/></svg></span><span>ĐIỀU KHIỂN NHANH</span></div>
              </div>
              <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px;">
                  <button class="btn-cmd" ng-class="conveyorRunning ? 'danger' : 'success'" ng-click="toggleMotor()" style="justify-content: center;">
                    <span ng-if="!conveyorRunning" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                      <svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg>
                      <span>BẬT MOTOR</span>
                    </span>
                    <span ng-if="conveyorRunning" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                      <svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2"/></svg>
                      <span>DỪNG MOTOR</span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <button class="btn-cmd warning" ng-click="toggleMode()" style="justify-content: center;">
                    <span ng-if="systemMode === 'AUTO'" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                      <svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 20V10M12 20V4M6 20v-6"/></svg>
                      <span>CHUYỂN THỦ CÔNG</span>
                    </span>
                    <span ng-if="systemMode !== 'AUTO'" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                      <svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"/></svg>
                      <span>SANG TỰ ĐỘNG</span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="width: 100%; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;" ng-click="switchTab('control')">
                  <svg class="scada-icon" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="6" y1="3" x2="6" y2="15"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><path d="M18 9a9 9 0 0 1-9 9"/></svg>
                  <span>MỞ TRUNG TÂM ĐIỀU KHIỂN CHI TIẾT</span>
                  <svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="7" y1="17" x2="17" y2="7"/><polyline points="7 7 17 7 17 17"/></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hàng dưới: 3 Panel thông tin rút gọn -->
        <div class="overview-bottom-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px;">
          <!-- Biểu đồ nhỏ sản lượng gần đây -->
          <div class="card-panel" style="padding: 10px 14px;">
            <div class="section-header-row" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">
              <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/></svg></span><span>HIỆU SUẤT 10 CHU KỲ</span></div>
              <span style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--cyan-primary); cursor: pointer;" ng-click="switchTab('monitoring', 'analytics')">Chi tiết ↗</span>
            </div>
            <div style="height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; padding-top: 6px;">
              <div ng-repeat="bar in displayCycles track by $index" style="flex: 1; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center;">
                <div style="width: 100%; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; transition: height 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;" ng-style="{'height': (bar.isReal ? bar.h : 0) + '%', 'opacity': bar.isReal ? 1 : 0, 'background': 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--cyan-primary), #0284c7)'}"></div>
                <div ng-if="!bar.isReal" style="width: 100%; height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); margin-bottom: 1px;"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Cảnh báo mới nhất (Đồng bộ nhiệt độ thực tế, KHÔNG phát sinh ALM-THRM-001 khi nhiệt < 45°C) -->
          <div class="card-panel" style="padding: 10px 14px;">
            <div class="section-header-row" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">
              <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg></span><span>LỊCH SỬ 5 SỰ KIỆN GẦN NHẤT</span></div>
              <a href="" ng-click="switchTab('monitoring', 'alarms')" style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--cyan-primary); text-decoration: none;">Xem Alarms ({{unackAlarmsCount}}) ↗</a>
            </div>
            <!-- 5 Sự kiện gần nhất -->
            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 8.5px;">
              <div ng-repeat="evt in recentEvents | limitTo:5" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 3px 6px; background: var(--panel-secondary); border-radius: 4px; border-left: 3px solid;" ng-style="{'border-left-color': evt.type === 'danger' ? 'var(--color-danger)' : (evt.type === 'warn' ? 'var(--color-warning)' : 'var(--cyan-primary)')}">
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
                  <span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 7.5px;">{{evt.time}}</span>
                  <span class="status-pill" ng-class="evt.type === 'danger' ? 'danger' : (evt.type === 'warn' ? 'warning' : 'online')" style="font-size: 7px; padding: 1px 4px;">{{evt.cat}}</span>
                  <span style="color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 8px;">{{evt.text}}</span>
                </div>
                <span style="font-size: 7px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono);">OK</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

                    <!-- Card 3: CẢNH BÁO ĐANG HOẠT ĐỘNG (ACTIVE ALARMS) -->
          <div class="card-panel" style="padding: 10px 14px;">
            <div class="section-header-row" style="margin-bottom: 6px;">
              <div class="section-title" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                <span class="scada-icon" style="color: var(--color-danger);"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"/></svg></span>
                <span>CẢNH BÁO ĐANG HOẠT ĐỘNG (ACTIVE ALARMS)</span>
                <span class="nav-badge-pill badge-danger" ng-if="unackAlarmsCount > 0" style="margin-left: 4px; font-size: 7.5px;">{{unackAlarmsCount}} CẦN XỬ LÝ</span>
              </div>
              <a href="javascript:void(0)" ng-click="switchTab('monitoring', 'alarms')" style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--cyan-primary); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700;">Xem tất cả ↗</a>
            </div>

            <!-- Khi không có cảnh báo nghiêm trọng -->
            <div ng-if="unackAlarmsCount === 0" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 78px; gap: 4px; background: rgba(49, 214, 160, 0.03); border: 1px dashed rgba(49, 214, 160, 0.25); border-radius: 6px;">
              <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-success); font-weight: 800; font-size: 10px;">
                <svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
                <span>HỆ THỐNG HOẠT ĐỘNG BÌNH THƯỜNG</span>
              </div>
              <div style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono);">
                Tất cả thiết bị sẵn sàng • 0 cảnh báo tồn đọng
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Khi có cảnh báo active -->
            <div ng-if="unackAlarmsCount > 0" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; max-height: 85px; overflow-y: auto;">
              <div ng-repeat="alm in alarmsList | filter:{active: true} | limitTo:3" style="background: rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.08); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-danger); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                <div>
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
                    <span class="cmd-badge cmd-stop" style="font-size: 7px; padding: 1px 4px;">{{alm.code}}</span>
                    <span style="font-weight: 700; color: #fff; font-size: 8.5px;">{{alm.desc}}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 1px;">Khắc phục: {{alm.remedy}}</div>
                </div>
                <button class="btn-cmd warning" style="padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 7.5px;" ng-click="ackAlarm(alm)">Xác nhận</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ============================================================== -->
      <!-- TAB 2: DEVICE CONTROL (TRUNG TÂM ĐIỀU KHIỂN THIẾT BỊ)          -->
      <!-- ============================================================== -->
      <div ng-show="activeTab === 'control'">
<div class="control-grid-layout" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 14px;">

          <!-- Card 1: Điều khiển Motor 24VDC (Bố cục 2 cột: Nút START/STOP thống nhất + 4 trạng thái trực quan) -->
          <div class="card-panel">
            <div class="section-header-row">
              <div class="section-title">
                <span class="section-title-icon">
                  <svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M10 15l5-3-5-3v6z"/>
                  </svg>
                </span>
                <span>ĐIỀU KHIỂN ĐỘNG CƠ BĂNG TẢI (MOTOR 24V)</span>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill" ng-class="conveyorRunning ? 'online' : 'offline'" style="font-size: 9px; padding: 2px 10px; font-weight: 700;">
                {{conveyorRunning ? 'RUNNING' : 'STOPPED'}}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.4;">
              Động cơ giảm tốc 24VDC kéo băng tải qua rulo chủ động • Khóa liên động tự ngắt an toàn khi E-STOP.
            </div>

            <div ng-if="isEstopTripped" style="padding: 6px 12px; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-danger); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 9px; color: var(--color-danger); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
              <span style="font-size: 14px;">⚠️</span>
              <span><b>KHÓA LIÊN ĐỘNG AN TOÀN:</b> Đang kích hoạt E-STOP. Vui lòng mở khóa E-STOP trên thanh Topbar trước khi bật động cơ.</span>
            </div>

            <!-- BỐ CỤC 2 CỘT: BÊN TRÁI NÚT ĐIỀU KHIỂN NGANG DUY NHẤT - BÊN PHẢI 4 HÀNG TRẠNG THÁI LUCIDE -->
            <div class="control-card-body" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: center;">
              <!-- Cột trái: Nút START / STOP dạng ngang, cân đối, icon bên trái, chữ giữa, mô tả dưới -->
              <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;">
                <button class="btn-cmd unified-motor-btn"
                        ng-click="toggleMotor()"
                        ng-disabled="isEstopTripped"
                        style="width: 100%; height: 68px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 10px; gap: 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s ease-in-out; border: 2px solid; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box;"
                        ng-style="!conveyorRunning ? {
                          'background': isEstopTripped ? 'rgba(39,197,139,0.06)' : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6,78,59,0.95), rgba(4,120,87,0.85))',
                          'border-color': isEstopTripped ? '#164e63' : '#10b981',
                          'color': isEstopTripped ? 'var(--text-muted)' : '#ffffff',
                          'box-shadow': isEstopTripped ? 'none' : '0 4px 16px rgba(16,185,129,0.3)',
                          'cursor': isEstopTripped ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer'
                        } : {
                          'background': 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(127,29,29,0.95), rgba(153,27,27,0.85))',
                          'border-color': '#ef4444',
                          'color': '#ffffff',
                          'box-shadow': '0 4px 16px rgba(239,68,68,0.35)',
                          'cursor': 'pointer'
                        }">
                  <!-- Icon bên trái (Play / Square Lucide style) -->
                  <div style="flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.28);">
                    <svg ng-if="!conveyorRunning" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                      <polygon points="6 4 20 12 6 20 6 4"/>
                    </svg>
                    <svg ng-if="conveyorRunning" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                      <rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="2" ry="2"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>

                  <!-- Chữ START / STOP ở giữa theo chiều ngang và dòng mô tả bên dưới -->
                  <div style="flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;">
                    <span style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1.5px; line-height: 1.15;">
                      {{conveyorRunning ? 'STOP' : 'START'}}
                    </span>
                    <span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.88; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-top: 2px;">
                      {{conveyorRunning ? 'DỪNG BĂNG TẢI' : (isEstopTripped ? 'KHÓA DO E-STOP' : 'KHỞI ĐỘNG BĂNG TẢI')}}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>

              <!-- Cột phải: 4 hàng trạng thái Lucide (Icon trái | Tên giữa | Giá trị lớn bên phải) -->
              <div class="status-tiers-col" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); justify-content: space-between;">
                <!-- 1. COMMAND (Lucide radio-tower) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--cyan-primary); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <path d="M4.9 16.1C1 12.2 1 5.8 4.9 1.9"/>
                      <path d="M7.8 13.3c-2.4-2.4-2.4-6.2 0-8.6"/>
                      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="2"/>
                      <path d="M16.2 4.7c2.4 2.4 2.4 6.2 0 8.6"/>
                      <path d="M19.1 1.9C23 5.8 23 12.2 19.1 16.1"/>
                      <path d="M12 11v11"/>
                      <path d="M8 22h8"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">

                  </div>

                       ng-style="{'color': conveyorRunning ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                    {{conveyorRunning ? 'COIL 0x0000 = 1 (START)' : 'COIL 0x0000 = 0 (STOP)'}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 2. FEEDBACK (Lucide activity) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--color-success); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    FEEDBACK
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': !modbusOnline ? 'var(--color-warning)' : (conveyorRunning ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--text-muted)')}">
                    <span ng-if="!modbusOnline" style="color: var(--color-warning); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                      <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3Z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg> MẤT TÍN HIỆU
                    </span>
                    <span ng-if="modbusOnline && conveyorRunning">RUNNING (180 RPM)</span>
                    <span ng-if="modbusOnline && !conveyorRunning">STOPPED (ĐÃ NGẮT)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 3. ACTUAL STATE (Lucide settings) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--cyan-primary); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                      <path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    ACTUAL STATE
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': conveyorRunning ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                    {{conveyorRunning ? 'Relay Ch.1 ĐÓNG (ON)' : 'Relay Ch.1 MỞ (OFF)'}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 4. INTERLOCK (Lucide shield-check) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; flex-shrink: 0;"
                       ng-style="{'color': !isEstopTripped ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--color-danger)'}">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
                      <polyline points="9 12 11 14 15 10"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    INTERLOCK
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': !isEstopTripped ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--color-danger)'}">
                    <span ng-if="!isEstopTripped">✓ CHO PHÉP (PERMISSIVE)</span>
                    <span ng-if="isEstopTripped">▲ BLOCKED: E-STOP TRIPPED</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 2: Chế độ vận hành (Operation Mode) -->
          <div class="card-panel">
            <div class="section-header-row">
              <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 14.5L12 19l8-4.5"/><path d="M4 9.5L12 14l8-4.5"/><path d="M12 2L4 6.5l8 4.5 8-4.5L12 2z"/></svg></span><span>CHẾ ĐỘ VẬN HÀNH (OPERATION MODE)</span></div>
              <span class="mode-badge" ng-class="systemMode === 'AUTO' ? 'auto' : 'manual'">{{systemMode}}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.4;">
              - <b>TỰ ĐỘNG (AUTO):</b> Cảm biến LJ12A3 tự động phát hiện phôi và kích hoạt chu kỳ gạt.<br>
              - <b>THỦ CÔNG (MANUAL):</b> Cho phép kỹ sư kiểm tra thiết bị qua nút nhấn giữ Solenoid.
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
              <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="flex: 1; justify-content: center; padding: 12px;" ng-click="setMode('AUTO')" ng-class="{'disabled': systemMode === 'AUTO'}">
                <span>⚙ CHẾ ĐỘ TỰ ĐỘNG</span>
              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd warning" style="flex: 1; justify-content: center; padding: 12px;" ng-click="setMode('MANUAL')" ng-class="{'disabled': systemMode === 'MANUAL'}">
                <span>🖐 CHẾ ĐỘ THỦ CÔNG</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--color-warning);">
              <span>⚠ Chú ý: Ở chế độ TỰ ĐỘNG, các nút kích thử nghiệm Solenoid sẽ bị khóa để bảo đảm an toàn.</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 3: Điều khiển Solenoid (Bố cục 2 cột: Nút Dead-man lớn + 4 trạng thái trực quan, đã loại bỏ nút 0.8s) -->
          <div class="card-panel">
            <div class="section-header-row">
              <div class="section-title">
                <span class="section-title-icon">⚡</span>
                <span>ĐIỀU KHIỂN CƠ CẤU GẠT SOLENOID (DEAD-MAN SWITCH)</span>
              </div>
              <span class="status-pill" ng-class="solenoidActive ? 'online' : 'offline'" style="font-size: 9px; padding: 2px 10px; font-weight: 700;">
                {{solenoidActive ? 'ACTIVE (42°)' : 'STANDBY (0°)'}}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.4;">
              Cơ cấu gạt Solenoid JF-0826B 12VDC • Nút Dead-man tự ngắt an toàn chống cháy cuộn dây sau 2.0s.
            </div>

            <!-- BỐ CỤC 2 CỘT: BÊN TRÁI NÚT DEAD-MAN SWITCH - BÊN PHẢI 4 HÀNG TRẠNG THÁI -->
            <div class="control-card-body" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: center;">
              <!-- Cột trái: Nút Dead-man Switch dạng ngang bằng nút bật tắt băng tải, icon tia sét, chữ NHẤN GIỮ ĐỂ GẠT / SOLENOID ACTIVE -->
              <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;">
                <button class="btn-cmd unified-solenoid-btn"
                        id="btn-control-deadman"
                        ng-disabled="systemMode !== 'MANUAL' || isEstopTripped || solenoidTemp >= 60"
                        ng-mousedown="onSolenoidPressDown($event)"
                        ng-mouseup="onSolenoidPressUp($event)"
                        ng-mouseleave="onSolenoidPressUp($event)"
                        style="width: 100%; height: 68px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 10px; gap: 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); border: 2px solid; user-select: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box;"
                        ng-style="systemMode !== 'MANUAL' || isEstopTripped || solenoidTemp >= 60 ? {
                          'background': 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
                          'border-color': 'var(--border-neutral)',
                          'color': 'var(--text-muted)',
                          'cursor': 'not-allowed',
                          'box-shadow': 'none'
                        } : (solenoidHeld ? {
                          'background': 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.5), rgba(220,38,38,0.35))',
                          'border-color': 'var(--color-danger)',
                          'color': '#ffffff',
                          'box-shadow': '0 0 24px rgba(239,68,68,0.7)',
                          'cursor': 'pointer'
                        } : {
                          'background': 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(40,184,232,0.18), rgba(2,132,199,0.12))',
                          'border-color': 'var(--cyan-primary)',
                          'color': '#ffffff',
                          'box-shadow': '0 4px 16px rgba(40,184,232,0.25)',
                          'cursor': 'pointer'
                        })">
                  <!-- Icon bên trái (36x36 lightning icon box) -->
                  <div style="flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.28); color: var(--cyan-primary);">
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>

                  <!-- Chữ NHẤN GIỮ ĐỂ GẠT ở giữa và dòng mô tả bên dưới -->
                  <div style="flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;">
                    <span style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.5px; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap;">
                      {{solenoidHeld ? 'SOLENOID ACTIVE' : 'NHẤN GIỮ ĐỂ GẠT'}}
                    </span>
                    <span style="font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.88; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-top: 2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                      {{solenoidHeld ? '🔴 ĐANG GẠT • 2.0s' : (systemMode === 'MANUAL' ? 'DEAD-MAN • NHẢ ĐỂ THU' : 'KHÓA NÚT Ở AUTO')}}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>

              <!-- Cột phải: 4 trạng thái trực quan với icon tiêu chuẩn, không đánh số, chữ lớn nổi bật -->
              <div class="status-tiers-col" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); justify-content: space-between;">
                <!-- 1. COMMAND (Lucide radio-tower) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--cyan-primary); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <path d="M4.9 16.1C1 12.2 1 5.8 4.9 1.9"/>
                      <path d="M7.8 13.3c-2.4-2.4-2.4-6.2 0-8.6"/>
                      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="2"/>
                      <path d="M16.2 4.7c2.4 2.4 2.4 6.2 0 8.6"/>
                      <path d="M19.1 1.9C23 5.8 23 12.2 19.1 16.1"/>
                      <path d="M12 11v11"/>
                      <path d="M8 22h8"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    COMMAND
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': solenoidActive ? 'var(--color-danger)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                    {{solenoidActive ? 'COIL 0x0001 = 1 (ACT)' : 'COIL 0x0001 = 0 (OFF)'}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 2. FEEDBACK (Lucide activity) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--color-warning); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    FEEDBACK
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': solenoidActive ? 'var(--color-danger)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                    {{solenoidActive ? 'ACTUATING (GẠT 42°)' : 'STANDBY (CHỜ 0°)'}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 3. ACTUAL STATE (Lucide settings) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; color: var(--cyan-primary); flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                      <path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    ACTUAL STATE
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;"
                       ng-style="{'color': solenoidTemp >= 60 ? 'var(--color-danger)' : (solenoidTemp >= 45 ? 'var(--color-warning)' : 'var(--color-success)')}">
                    JF-0826B 12V • {{solenoidTemp | number:1}}°C
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 4. INTERLOCK (Lucide shield-check) -->
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border-radius: 6px;">
                  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 22px; flex-shrink: 0;">
                    <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                      <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
                      <polyline points="9 12 11 14 15 10"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); width: 80px; padding-left: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; white-space: nowrap;">
                    INTERLOCK
                  </div>
                  <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap;">
                    <span ng-if="systemMode === 'MANUAL' && solenoidTemp < 60 && !isEstopTripped" style="color: var(--color-success);">✓ CHO PHÉP (PERMISSIVE)</span>
                    <span ng-if="systemMode === 'AUTO'" style="color: var(--color-warning);">⚠ AUTO LOCKOUT</span>
                    <span ng-if="isEstopTripped" style="color: var(--color-danger);">▲ E-STOP TRIPPED</span>
                    <span ng-if="solenoidTemp >= 60" style="color: var(--color-danger);">▲ THERMAL TRIP (>60°C)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Card 4: Quản lý Reset & Xóa số liệu -->
          <div class="card-panel">
            <div class="section-header-row">
              <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon">🗑</span><span>RESET SỐ LIỆU CHỌN LỌC & FACTORY CLEAR</span></div>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.4;">
              Các thao tác reset được phân tách rõ ràng để tránh xóa nhầm dữ liệu trong ca sản xuất:
            </div>

            <div class="reset-buttons-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
              <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="justify-content: center; padding: 8px;" ng-click="resetSelective('metal')">
                <span>Fe</span><span>XÓA ĐẾM PHÔI (VỀ 0)</span>
              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="justify-content: center; padding: 8px;" ng-click="resetSelective('stats')">
                <span>⏱</span><span>XÓA THỐNG KÊ</span>
              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="justify-content: center; padding: 8px;" ng-click="resetSelective('chart')">
                <span>📊</span><span>XÓA BIỂU ĐỒ</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <button class="btn-cmd danger" style="width: 100%; justify-content: center; padding: 10px;" ng-click="triggerFactoryClear()">
              <span>▲ RESET TOÀN BỘ SỐ LIỆU (FACTORY CLEAR)</span>
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ============================================================== -->
      <!-- TAB 3: MONITORING & ANALYTICS (GIÁM SÁT & PHÂN TÍCH TỔNG HỢP)    -->
      <!-- ============================================================== -->
      <div ng-show="activeTab === 'monitoring'">
        <!-- Secondary Subtab Navigation Bar -->
        <div class="secondary-subtab-bar">
          <button class="subtab-pill" ng-class="{'is-active': monitoringSubTab === 'analytics'}" ng-click="monitoringSubTab = 'analytics'">
            <svg class="scada-icon" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/></svg>
            <span>A. PHÂN TÍCH SẢN XUẤT (ANALYTICS)</span>
          </button>
          <button class="subtab-pill" ng-class="{'is-active': monitoringSubTab === 'modbus'}" ng-click="monitoringSubTab = 'modbus'">
            <svg class="scada-icon" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/></svg>
            <span>B. TRUYỀN THÔNG MODBUS RTU (SNIFFER)</span>
          </button>
          <button class="subtab-pill" ng-class="{'is-active': monitoringSubTab === 'alarms'}" ng-click="monitoringSubTab = 'alarms'">
            <svg class="scada-icon" width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"/></svg>
            <span>C. QUẢN LÝ CẢNH BÁO & SỰ KIỆN (ALARMS)</span>
            <span class="nav-badge-pill badge-danger" ng-if="unackAlarmsCount > 0" style="margin-left: 4px;">{{unackAlarmsCount}}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <!-- KHU VỰC A: PHÂN TÍCH TỐC ĐỘ CẤP PHÔI & SẢN LƯỢNG SẢN XUẤT -->
        <div ng-show="monitoringSubTab === 'analytics'">
          <div class="card-panel" style="margin-bottom: 14px;">
            <div class="section-header-row">
              <div class="section-title">
                <span class="section-title-icon">
                  <svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/>
                  </svg>
                </span>
                <span>PHÂN TÍCH TỐC ĐỘ CẤP PHÔI & SẢN LƯỢNG SẢN XUẤT</span>
              </div>
              <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
                <button class="btn-cmd success" ng-click="exportAnalyticsCSV()">
                  <span>📥 XUẤT BÁO CÁO PHÁT HIỆN PHÔI & SẢN LƯỢNG (CSV)</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- BỘ LỌC THỐNG KÊ THEO CA & NGÀY (THỰC TẾ ASIA/HO_CHI_MINH) -->
            <div class="filter-pill-row" style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); margin-bottom: 12px;">
              <span style="font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">CA SẢN XUẤT:</span>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsShiftFilter === 'ALL'}" ng-click="setShiftFilter('ALL')">TẤT CẢ CÁC CA</button>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsShiftFilter === 'SHIFT1'}" ng-click="setShiftFilter('SHIFT1')">CA 1 (06:00 - 14:00)</button>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsShiftFilter === 'SHIFT2'}" ng-click="setShiftFilter('SHIFT2')">CA 2 (14:00 - 22:00)</button>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsShiftFilter === 'SHIFT3'}" ng-click="setShiftFilter('SHIFT3')">CA 3 (22:00 - 06:00)</button>

              <span style="font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-left: 10px;">THỜI GIAN:</span>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsDateFilter === 'TODAY'}" ng-click="setDateFilter('TODAY')">HÔM NAY</button>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsDateFilter === '24H'}" ng-click="setDateFilter('24H')">24 GIỜ QUA</button>
              <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': analyticsDateFilter === '7D'}" ng-click="setDateFilter('7D')">7 NGÀY QUA</button>
            </div>

            <!-- 4 KPI SẢN XUẤT THỰC TẾ TỪ CẢM BIẾN TIỆM CẬN LJ12A3 -->
            <div class="analytics-kpi-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px;">
              <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                <div style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">1. TỔNG SẢN LƯỢNG</div>
                <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--cyan-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); margin: 3px 0;">
                  {{filteredProductionCount}} <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-secondary);">phôi</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);">Tổng phôi phát hiện trong khoảng thời gian</div>
              </div>
              <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                <div style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">2. SẢN LƯỢNG TRUNG BÌNH</div>
                <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--color-success); font-family: var(--font-mono); margin: 3px 0;">
                  {{avgHourlyProduction}} <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--color-success);">phôi/giờ</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);">Tính theo khung giờ thực tế đã chọn</div>
              </div>
              <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                <div style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">3. KHOẢNG CÁCH PHÁT HIỆN TB</div>
                <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-mono); margin: 3px 0;">
                  {{avgDetectionInterval !== '---' ? (avgDetectionInterval | number:1) + 's' : '---'}}
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);">Độ ổn định dòng phôi: <b ng-style="{'color': flowStabilityStatus.includes('ỔN ĐỊNH') ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--color-warning)'}">{{flowStabilityStatus}}</b></div>
              </div>
              <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                <div style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">4. TỔNG SỐ SỰ KIỆN PHÁT HIỆN</div>
                <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-mono); margin: 3px 0;">
                  {{filteredProductionCount}} <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-secondary);">sự kiện</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);">Sườn lên LJ12A3 (Debounce chống trùng)</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- BIỂU ĐỒ 1.2: SẢN LƯỢNG PHÔI THEO GIỜ -->
            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 14px;">
              <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px;">
                <span style="font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">SẢN LƯỢNG PHÔI THEO GIỜ</span>
                <span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--cyan-primary);">
                  Tổng theo bộ lọc: <b>{{filteredProductionCount}} phôi</b> <span style="color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: 8px;">Múi giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh</span>
                </span>
              </div>

              <div style="height: 110px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                <div ng-repeat="bar in hourlyProductionBars track by $index" style="flex: 1; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 4px;" title="Khung giờ {{bar.hourLabel}}: {{bar.count}} phôi">
                  <span style="font-size: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--text-muted);">{{bar.count}}</span>
                  <div style="width: 100%; max-width: 28px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; transition: height 0.3s ease;"
                       ng-style="{
                         'height': bar.h + '%',
                         'background': bar.count > 0 ? 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--cyan-primary), #0284c7)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'
                       }">
                  </div>
                  <span style="font-size: 7.5px; font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">{{bar.hourLabel}}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- BIỂU ĐỒ 1.1: KHOẢNG CÁCH GIỮA CÁC LẦN PHÁT HIỆN PHÔI (GIÂY) -->
            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 14px;">
              <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <span style="font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">KHOẢNG CÁCH GIỮA CÁC LẦN PHÁT HIỆN PHÔI (GIÂY)</span>
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;">
                  <span style="color: var(--color-warning); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600;">--- Khoảng cách TB: {{avgDetectionInterval !== '---' ? (avgDetectionInterval | number:1) + 's' : '0.0s'}}</span>
                  <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;">
                    <span ng-if="totalFilteredCycles > 10"><span style="color: var(--cyan-primary); font-weight: 700;">10 khoảng cách gần nhất</span> (Tổng: {{totalFilteredCycles}} phôi)</span>
                    <span ng-if="totalFilteredCycles <= 10">Đã ghi nhận: {{cycleCountReal}}/10</span>
                  </span>
                  <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 8px;" ng-click="simulateNewCycle()">+ Thêm phát hiện test</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style="height: 125px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; position: relative; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                <!-- Đường tham chiếu khoảng cách trung bình -->
                <div ng-if="avgDetectionInterval !== '---' && avgDetectionInterval > 0" style="position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 50%; border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--color-warning); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.85; z-index: 1;">
                  <span style="position: absolute; right: 4px; top: -11px; font-size: 7.5px; color: var(--color-warning); font-family: var(--font-mono); background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 0 4px;">TB {{avgDetectionInterval}}s</span>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Cố định luôn luôn hiển thị đúng 10 slot (#1 đến #10) của 10 lần gần nhất -->
                <div ng-repeat="bar in displayCycles track by $index" style="flex: 1; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 4px; position: relative; z-index: 2;" title="Slot #{{$index + 1}}: {{bar.isReal ? ('Phôi Fe #' + bar.workpieceNum + ' • ' + (bar.val > 0 ? (bar.val + 's') : 'Khởi đầu') + ' • ' + bar.status) : 'Chưa có dữ liệu'}}">
                  <!-- Nhãn giá trị khoảng cách phát hiện -->
                  <span style="font-size: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono); transition: all 0.3s;" ng-style="{'color': bar.isReal ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)', 'font-weight': bar.isReal ? '700' : '400'}">
                    {{bar.isReal ? (bar.val > 0 ? (bar.val | number:1) + 's' : '0.0s') : '0.0s'}}
                  </span>

                  <!-- Cột hiển thị: Height = 0% và Opacity = 0 nếu không có dữ liệu thực tế -->
                  <div style="width: 100%; max-width: 32px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; transition: height 0.4s ease, opacity 0.4s ease;"
                       ng-style="{
                         'height': (bar.isReal ? bar.h : 0) + '%',
                         'opacity': bar.isReal ? 1 : 0,
                         'background': 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--cyan-primary), #0284c7)'
                       }">
                  </div>

                  <!-- Đáy rãnh vị trí khi chưa có dữ liệu để giữ nhịp trực quan -->
                  <div ng-if="!bar.isReal" style="width: 80%; height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 1px; margin-bottom: 2px;"></div>

                  <!-- Nhãn slot số thứ tự #1 -> #10 -->
                  <span style="font-size: 7.5px; font-family: var(--font-mono);" ng-style="{'color': bar.isReal ? 'var(--cyan-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">#{{$index + 1}}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- BẢNG 1.5: BẢNG LỊCH SỬ PHÁT HIỆN PHÔI -->
            <div class="scada-table-wrap">
              <table class="scada-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th style="width: 70px;">STT</th>
                    <th style="width: 140px;">THỜI ĐIỂM PHÁT HIỆN</th>
                    <th>KHOẢNG CÁCH VỚI LẦN PHÁT HIỆN TRƯỚC (S)</th>
                    <th style="width: 160px;">TRẠNG THÁI DỮ LIỆU</th>
                    <th style="width: 140px;">MÃ PHÔI</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  <tr ng-repeat="bar in displayCycles track by $index" ng-style="{'opacity': bar.isReal ? 1 : 0.55}">
                    <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600;">#{{$index + 1}}</td>
                    <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                      {{bar.isReal ? (bar.timeStr ? bar.timeStr : '---') : '---'}}
                    </td>
                    <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700;" ng-style="{'color': bar.isReal ? 'var(--cyan-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                      {{bar.isReal ? (bar.val > 0 ? (bar.val | number:1) + 's' : '--- (Khởi đầu)') : '0.0s'}}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span ng-if="bar.isReal && bar.val > 0" class="status-pill online" style="font-size: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; font-weight: 600;">
                        HỢP LỆ
                      </span>
                      <span ng-if="bar.isReal && bar.val <= 0" class="status-pill warning" style="font-size: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--cyan-primary);">
                        KHỞI ĐẦU
                      </span>
                      <span ng-if="!bar.isReal" class="status-pill offline" style="font-size: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; opacity: 0.7;">
                        CHƯA CÓ DỮ LIỆU
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 8.5px;">
                      <span ng-if="bar.isReal && bar.workpieceNum" style="color: var(--cyan-primary); font-weight: 600;">Phôi Fe #{{bar.workpieceNum}}</span>
                      <span ng-if="!bar.isReal || !bar.workpieceNum" style="color: var(--text-muted);">---</span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- KHU VỰC B: MODBUS MONITOR -->
        <div ng-show="monitoringSubTab === 'modbus'">
<div class="card-panel">
          <div class="section-header-row">
            <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/></svg></span><span>MODBUS RTU PACKET SNIFFER & TRAFFIC MONITOR (COM4)</span></div>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
              <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 9px;" ng-click="toggleModbusPause()">
                <span ng-if="!isModbusPaused">⏸ Tạm dừng feed</span>
                <span ng-if="isModbusPaused">▶ Tiếp tục feed</span>
              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd warning" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 9px;" ng-click="clearModbusLogs()">
                <span>🗑 Xóa log</span>
              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd success" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 9px;" ng-click="exportModbusCSV()">
                <span>📥 Xuất CSV</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- BẢNG GIÁM SÁT THANH GHI THỜI GIAN THỰC (LIVE REGISTER WATCH) -->
          <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
            <div style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between;">
              <span>LIVE REGISTER WATCH (BẢNG THANH GHI THỜI GIAN THỰC ĐÃ XÁC THỰC)</span>
              <span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--cyan-primary);">POLL RATE: 150ms • SLAVE: 0xFF / 0x01</span>
            </div>
            <div class="reg-watch-grid">
              <div class="reg-watch-card">
                <div class="reg-watch-addr">COIL 0x0000 [R/W]</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-label">Động cơ băng chuyền 24V</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-val" ng-style="{'color': conveyorRunning ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                  {{conveyorRunning ? '1 [RUN]' : '0 [STOP]'}}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="reg-watch-card">
                <div class="reg-watch-addr">COIL 0x0001 [R/W]</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-label">Cơ cấu Solenoid Fe</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-val" ng-style="{'color': solenoidActive ? 'var(--color-danger)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                  {{solenoidActive ? '1 [ACT]' : '0 [OFF]'}}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="reg-watch-card">
                <div class="reg-watch-addr">DI 0x0000 [R]</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-label">Cảm biến từ LJ12A3 (IN1)</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-val" ng-style="{'color': sensorActive ? 'var(--color-warning)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">
                  {{sensorActive ? '1 [DETECTED]' : '0 [IDLE]'}}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="reg-watch-card">
                <div class="reg-watch-addr">HR 0x0000 [R/W]</div>
                <div class="reg-watch-label">Bộ đếm phôi Fe</div>

            </div>

            <span>TỔNG RX: <b>{{rxCount}}</b></span>

                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
        </div>

        <!-- KHU VỰC C: CẢNH BÁO & SỰ KIỆN -->
        <div ng-show="monitoringSubTab === 'alarms'">
<div class="card-panel">
          <div class="section-header-row">
            <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 8A6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.73 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.46 0"/></svg></span><span>TRUNG TÂM CẢNH BÁO & SỰ KIỆN CÔNG NGHIỆP</span></div>

              </button>

            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">

            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">

            </div>

            <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': alarmFilterGroup === 'COMM'}" ng-click="alarmFilterGroup = 'COMM'">COMMUNICATION</button>
            <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': alarmFilterGroup === 'SAFETY'}" ng-click="alarmFilterGroup = 'SAFETY'">SAFETY (E-STOP)</button>
            <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': alarmFilterGroup === 'THERMAL'}" ng-click="alarmFilterGroup = 'THERMAL'">TEMPERATURE</button>
            <button class="filter-pill-btn" ng-class="{'active': alarmFilterGroup === 'ACTUATOR'}" ng-click="alarmFilterGroup = 'ACTUATOR'">MOTOR & SOLENOID</button>

                  <th>MÃ LỖI</th>

                  <th>THỜI GIAN</th>
                  <th>MÔ TẢ CẢNH BÁO</th>
                  <th>TRẠNG THÁI</th>

              <tbody>
                <tr ng-repeat="alm in alarmsList track by $index">
                  <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; color: var(--cyan-primary);">{{alm.code}}</td>

                    <button class="btn-cmd primary" style="padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 8px;" ng-if="!alm.ack" ng-click="ackAlarm(alm)">ACK</button>
                    <span ng-if="alm.ack" style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 8px;">ĐÃ ACK</span>
                  </td>
                  <td style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 9px;">{{alm.remedy}}</td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div ng-show="activeTab === 'system'">

          <div class="section-header-row system-settings-header">
            <div class="section-title"><span class="section-title-icon"><svg class="scada-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="4" y1="21" x2="4" y2="14"/><line x1="4" y1="10" x2="4" y2="3"/><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="3"/><line x1="20" y1="21" x2="20" y2="16"/><line x1="20" y1="12" x2="20" y2="3"/><line x1="1" y1="14" x2="7" y2="14"/><line x1="9" y1="8" x2="15" y2="8"/><line x1="17" y1="16" x2="23" y2="16"/></svg></span><span>CẤU HÌNH THÔNG SỐ TRUYỀN THÔNG & GIỚI HẠN AN TOÀN</span></div>
            <div class="system-settings-actions" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">

              </button>
              <button class="btn-cmd success btn-save-cfg" ng-click="saveSettings()">💾 LƯU CẤU HÌNH</button>
            </div>
          </div>

                    <div style="padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); border: 1px solid var(--color-warning); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 9px; color: var(--color-warning); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">

            <span><b>LƯU Ý AN TOÀN:</b> Các giới hạn nhiệt độ Solenoid và chu kỳ Watchdog được cài đặt để chống cháy nổ thiết bị JF-0826B 12VDC. Không thay đổi vượt quá ngưỡng kiểm định an toàn (Max 60°C).</span>

          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; font-size: 10px;">

              <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--cyan-primary); margin-bottom: 8px;">1. THÔNG SỐ CỔNG SERIAL / MODBUS RTU</div>
              <div class="system-fields-grid">
                <div><span>Cổng COM:</span> <input type="text" value="COM4" style="width: 100%; background: var(--panel-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 2px;" readonly></div>
                <div><span>Baudrate:</span> <input type="text" value="9600" style="width: 100%; background: var(--panel-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 2px;" readonly></div>
                <div><span>Data / Parity / Stop:</span> <input type="text" value="8 - None - 1" style="width: 100%; background: var(--panel-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 2px;" readonly></div>
                <div><span>Slave ID Relay:</span> <input type="text" value="1" style="width: 100%; background: var(--panel-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 2px;" readonly></div>

            <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">

                <div><span>Ngưỡng cảnh báo nhiệt:</span> <input type="text" value="45.0 °C" style="width: 100%; background: var(--panel-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 2px;" readonly></div>

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

      <div class="dialog-top" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #240a12, #070d18); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">

          <span style="font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">CHI TIẾT CẢNH BÁO: {{selectedAlarm.code}}</span>

        <button style="background: rgba(255,91,104,0.2); border: 1px solid var(--color-danger); color: #fff; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 900;" ng-click="closeAlarmModal()">✕</button>
      </div>

      <div class="dialog-body" style="padding: 16px; background: #081022; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px;">
          <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
            <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 8px;">MÃ SỰ KIỆN</div>
            <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 800; color: var(--cyan-primary); margin-top: 2px;">{{selectedAlarm.code}}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
            <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 8px;">MỨC ĐỘ NGUY HIỂM</div>
            <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 800; margin-top: 2px;" ng-style="{'color': selectedAlarm.level === 'CRITICAL' ? 'var(--color-danger)' : 'var(--color-warning)'}">
              {{selectedAlarm.level}}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
            <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 8px;">THỜI ĐIỂM XẢY RA</div>
            <div style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; margin-top: 2px;">{{selectedAlarm.time}}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="background: var(--panel-secondary); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);">
          <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px;">NỘI DUNG MÔ TẢ</div>
          <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1.4;">{{selectedAlarm.desc}}</div>
        </div>

        <div style="background: rgba(246,185,75,0.08); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(246,185,75,0.3);">
          <div style="color: var(--color-warning); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4px;">HƯỚNG DẪN XỬ LÝ SỰ CỐ (REMEDY ACTION)</div>
          <div style="color: #e2e8f0; line-height: 1.4;">{{selectedAlarm.remedy}}</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); padding-top: 10px;">
          <div>
            <span style="font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--text-muted);">Trạng thái: </span>
            <b ng-style="{'color': selectedAlarm.active ? 'var(--color-danger)' : 'var(--color-success)'}">{{selectedAlarm.active ? 'ACTIVE (Đang diễn ra)' : 'CLEARED (Đã an toàn)'}}</b>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
            <button class="btn-cmd warning" ng-if="!selectedAlarm.ack" ng-click="ackAlarm(selectedAlarm); closeAlarmModal()" style="padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 9.5px;">XÁC NHẬN (ACK)</button>
            <button class="btn-cmd primary" ng-click="closeAlarmModal()" style="padding: 5px 16px; font-size: 9.5px;">Đóng</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TOAST NOTIFICATION -->
  <div class="toast-container" ng-if="toastMsg">
    <div class="toast-item">
      <span><svg class="scada-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg></span>
      <span>{{toastMsg}}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- MODAL: FACTORY CLEAR BẢO MẬT 2-BƯỚC VỚI MÃ PIN & CHECKLIST -->
  <div class="scada-dialog-backdrop" ng-if="showConfirmDialog" ng-click="closeFactoryClearModal()">
    <div class="scada-dialog-box" style="width: 500px;" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="dialog-top" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #380a10, #070d18); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-danger);">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <span style="color: var(--color-danger); font-size: 14px;">⚠️</span>
          <span style="font-weight: 800; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">XÁC THỰC FACTORY CLEAR (KHÔI PHỤC CÀI ĐẶT GỐC)</span>
        </div>
        <button style="background: none; border: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;" ng-click="closeFactoryClearModal()">✕</button>

      <!-- BƯỚC 1: NHẬP MÃ PIN QUẢN TRỊ / KỸ THUẬT -->
      <div class="dialog-body" ng-if="factoryClearStep === 1" style="padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div style="color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4;">
          Thao tác Factory Clear yêu cầu phân quyền Kỹ sư vận hành hoặc Quản trị viên. Vui lòng nhập mã PIN bảo mật để tiếp tục:
        </div>
        <div>
          <label style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--cyan-primary); font-weight: 700;">MÃ PIN BẢO MẬT (Mặc định: 9999 hoặc 1234):</label>
          <input type="password" ng-model="factoryClearPinInput" placeholder="Nhập mã PIN..." style="width: 100%; background: #040812; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 4px; margin-top: 4px;">
        </div>
        <div ng-if="factoryClearError" style="color: var(--color-danger); font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px;">
          ▲ {{factoryClearError}}
        </div>
        <div class="dialog-actions" style="margin-top: 10px;">
          <button class="btn-cmd" style="background: var(--panel-elevated); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);" ng-click="closeFactoryClearModal()">Hủy Bỏ</button>
          <button class="btn-cmd primary" ng-click="verifyFactoryClearPin()">Tiếp Tục (Bước 2/2) ↗</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- BƯỚC 2: CẢNH BÁO RỦI RO & CHECKLIST XÁC NHẬN CUỐI -->
      <div class="dialog-body" ng-if="factoryClearStep === 2" style="padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div style="background: rgba(255,91,104,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--color-danger); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4;">
          ▲ CẢNH BÁO RỦI RO CAO: Thao tác này sẽ xóa vĩnh viễn dữ liệu phiên sản xuất hiện tại. Các mục sau đây sẽ được đưa về giá trị 0 mặc định:
        </div>
        <ul style="color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.6;">
          <li>Bộ đếm sản lượng phôi Fe: Đưa về <b>0 phôi</b></li>
          <li>Toàn bộ nhật ký gói tin Modbus RTU Sniffer: <b>Xóa sạch</b></li>
          <li>Lịch sử chu kỳ và biểu đồ hiệu suất: <b>Làm mới về 3.8s chuẩn</b></li>
          <li>Cảnh báo nhiệt độ và trạng thái E-Stop: <b>Khôi phục định mức 30.0°C</b></li>
          <li>Ghi nhật ký Audit Trail: <b>Ghi lại danh tính Administrator & thời gian</b></li>
        </ul>
        <div class="dialog-actions" style="margin-top: 10px;">
          <button class="btn-cmd" style="background: var(--panel-elevated); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);" ng-click="factoryClearStep = 1">← Quay Lại</button>
          <button class="btn-cmd danger" ng-click="confirmFactoryClearFinal()">TÔI XÁC NHẬN RESET TOÀN BỘ (FACTORY CLEAR)</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- MODAL: NHẬP PIN MỞ KHÓA SETTINGS -->
  <div class="scada-dialog-backdrop" ng-if="showPinModal" ng-click="showPinModal = false">
    <div class="scada-dialog-box" style="width: 400px;" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="dialog-top">
        <div style="font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">XÁC THỰC KỸ THUẬT VIÊN</div>
        <button style="background: none; border: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer;" ng-click="showPinModal = false">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="dialog-body" style="padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div>Nhập mã PIN kỹ thuật viên để mở quyền chỉnh sửa tham số hệ thống (Mặc định: 9999):</div>
        <input type="password" ng-model="settingsPinInput" placeholder="Mã PIN..." style="background: #040812; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 4px;">
        <div ng-if="settingsPinError" style="color: var(--color-danger); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;">▲ {{settingsPinError}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="dialog-actions">
        <button class="btn-cmd" style="background: var(--panel-elevated); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);" ng-click="showPinModal = false">Hủy</button>
        <button class="btn-cmd primary" ng-click="confirmSettingsPin()">Mở Khóa Cấu Hình</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>



  <!-- ============================================================== -->
